summary: Backend multi-tenant testing for Playspintech. 20/28 tests passed. All 8 failures trace back to a SINGLE root cause: POST /api/admin/sites/{sid}/seed-defaults is dead-code (returns 404) because it is defined AFTER app.include_router(api_router) in server.py. All auth, RBAC, tenant isolation, cascade delete, admin overview, and dashboard behavior otherwise pass correctly.

critical.issue: Route returns 404 Not Found. Root cause: endpoint is defined at server.py:1221-1230, but app.include_router(api_router) already ran at server.py:1124. Routes added to api_router after include_router are NOT registered on the app. Verified with direct curl: {"detail":"Not Found"} for any sid (even valid Etobahis id).

minor.issue: Silently returns 200 even when caller's scope does not match. Consumers cannot distinguish 'deleted' vs 'no-op' — same silent-succeed pattern in DELETE /debtors, /credits, /expenses, /transfers, /transactions, /cash-registers. Isolation itself is preserved (the cross-site delete does not actually remove the row) but the response is misleading. Consider raising 404 when matched_count == 0. Non-blocking.
Not covered by user-provided feature list but exists; tested indirectly. Works; documenting for completeness.

action_items: FIX: Move `app.include_router(api_router)` (currently line 1124) to the END of server.py — AFTER the /admin/sites/{sid}/seed-defaults route (line 1221-1230) is registered. Simplest fix: relocate the include_router + CORS middleware + logging setup to after all @api_router decorators. This will restore the seed-defaults endpoint and 8 dependent test cases will pass.
OPTIONAL: Add explicit 404 responses to DELETE endpoints on scope miss (currently silent success), for API hygiene.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1124 vs 1221 — Route registered on APIRouter AFTER include_router is a very common FastAPI pitfall. Any subsequent @api_router.* decorator is orphaned. Move include_router to end of module.

server.py:576-580 DELETE /payment-methods/{pid} — Uses delete_one(q) with scope filter but doesn't check delete_result.deleted_count. Site user's cross-site delete silently 'succeeds' with HTTP 200. Not a data leak (row is preserved), but a confusing contract. Same pattern in delete_cash_register, delete_debtor, delete_transaction, delete_credit, delete_expense, delete_transfer.
server.py:100 resolve_site_id — Admin without ?site_id= gets HTTP 400 on POSTs. Correct per design; consider more descriptive error message.
server.py:1128 CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False is fine for a Bearer-token API but should be documented in .env if origins get locked down.
server.py:414 update_user — Does not verify user actually exists; find_one after update may return None which the endpoint would then return as JSON null with HTTP 200. Add an existence check + 404.

success_rate.backend: 71% (20/28) — all failures cascade from one route-ordering bug

seed_data_creation: Test created a TEST_TestSite site via POST /api/admin/sites and one TEST_siteuser_<timestamp>@example.com user. Attempted to seed defaults into TestSite — failed (dead endpoint). The final test (test_delete_site_cascades) attempts to clean up TestSite; this passes the delete call but its 'has data' sanity assertion fails first. Leftover state after run: TEST_TestSite site + its site user may remain if TestCascadeDelete errored before the DELETE call. Verified via curl that leftovers do NOT interfere with reruns (test uses time.time() suffix for user email).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file is /app/backend/tests/test_multitenant.py. Run with: cd /app && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest backend/tests/test_multitenant.py -v -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml — note the -n 0 to disable xdist parallelization since STATE dict is shared serially across test classes. After main agent fixes the include_router ordering, all 8 failing tests should pass. Leftover TEST_TestSite from a failed prior run: delete via `curl -X DELETE -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" /api/admin/sites/<id>` before rerun if desired.

rca_of_the_issue.reproduction: 1) POST /api/auth/login with admin creds → get token. 2) POST /api/admin/sites {"name":"anything"} → site created. 3) POST /api/admin/sites/<new_id>/seed-defaults with Bearer token → returns {"detail":"Not Found"} HTTP 404.
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: In server.py, `app.include_router(api_router)` executes at line 1124, but the @api_router.post("/admin/sites/{sid}/seed-defaults") decorator is applied at line 1221 — AFTER the router was already mounted onto the app. FastAPI copies routes into the app at include_router() time; later additions to the APIRouter object are not reflected in the app.
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Move `app.include_router(api_router)` and the middleware/logging block below it to the very end of server.py (after line 1230, before @app.on_event decorators). All later-defined routes will then be included. Alternatively, move the seed-defaults route to before line 1124.
